item.title: Chery Recalls Thousands of Vehicles in South Africa Over Safety
item.description: Chinese auto manufacturer Chery South Africa recalled thousands of vehicles to check for potential faults, and the nation’s consumer watchdog said it’s launched an investigation into the company.

item.title: CSG Shares Plunge as Defense Firm Cuts Full-Year Margin Outlook
item.description: CSG NV shares plunged to the lowest since their January listing after the European arms maker cut its full-year profitability outlook and reported third-quarter revenue that fell short of estimates.

item.title: Asia Tech Rally Defies SoftBank AI Concerns
item.description: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Sydney and Singapore with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Avril Hong, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Allianz CIO Says Markets Are Underestimating Inflation Surge
item.description: Allianz Chief Investment Officer and Chief Economist Ludovic Subran says, "The second inflation shock is not sized properly, not only by markets, but by policymakers." He speaks on Bloomberg Television after US short-term bond yields surged by the most in 19 months on a faster-than-expected rise in consumer prices and warnings by Federal Reserve officials that interest rates may need to be hiked more aggressively. (Source: Bloomberg)
